moments.title: UEFA Super Cup: PSG vs Aston Villa
moments.blurb: European club football kicks off its season with Champions League winners Paris Saint-Germain facing Europa League champions Aston Villa in the UEFA Super Cup in Salzburg, Austria.

angles.name: Match Hype
angles.copy: PSG vs Aston Villa in the UEFA Super Cup tomorrow! Who's taking home the first European silverware of the season? We're backing a big game.

angles.name: Aston Villa Focus
angles.copy: Aston Villa flying the flag for England in the UEFA Super Cup tomorrow! Can Emery's men start the season with a European trophy? Tune in for the build-up.

moments.title: Community Shield: Arsenal vs Man City in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, the traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, sees Premier League champions Manchester City face FA Cup winners Arsenal at Cardiff's Principality Stadium this Sunday.

angles.name: Cardiff Host
angles.copy: Cardiff is gearing up for a huge weekend as the Principality Stadium hosts the FA Community Shield! Arsenal vs Man City this Sunday – who's heading to the capital?

angles.name: Season Opener
angles.copy: The Premier League season is just around the corner, but first, it's the Community Shield! Arsenal take on Man City in Cardiff this Sunday. Who are you backing for the first silverware?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season for 2026/27 is set to kick off next weekend, bringing top-flight football back to England.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Get ready, the Premier League returns next weekend! What are your predictions for the 2026/27 season? Who's lifting the trophy?

angles.name: Fantasy Football
angles.copy: Fantasy Football managers, assemble! With the Premier League kicking off next weekend, it's time to finalise those squads. Who's in your starting XI?

moments.title: Joss Stone plays London's Crystal Palace Bowl
moments.blurb: Soul sensation Joss Stone is performing in London this August as part of a tour hitting Crystal Palace Bowl, alongside Leon Thomas, Brooke Combe and DE'WAYNE.

angles.name: London Gig Alert
angles.copy: Joss Stone bringing her incredible voice to Crystal Palace Bowl this August! Who's excited for a night of pure soul in London?

angles.name: Summer Sounds
angles.copy: Summer nights and live music! Joss Stone is lighting up Crystal Palace Bowl this month. Perfect vibes for a warm August evening.

moments.title: Scottish Schools Return from Summer Holidays
moments.blurb: While many in the UK are still enjoying their summer break, schools across Scotland, including Edinburgh, are heading back this week.

angles.name: Back to School Scotland
angles.copy: The summer holidays are officially over for many in Scotland, with schools heading back this week! Good luck to all students and teachers.

angles.name: Summer's Not Over Yet (for some)
angles.copy: While Scottish schools are back in session, a reminder that many across England and Wales still have a few weeks left of summer holidays! Make the most of it!

moments.title: Mike Hugg of Manfred Mann is 86
moments.blurb: Mike Hugg, drummer and founding member of the iconic 60s group Manfred Mann, celebrates his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: 60s Legend
angles.copy: Happy 86th Birthday to Mike Hugg! The drumming legend from Manfred Mann, who gave us 'Do Wah Diddy Diddy', is still going strong.

moments.title: Dire Straits' Mark Knopfler turns 77
moments.blurb: Guitar icon Mark Knopfler, best known as the frontman of Dire Straits, will celebrate his 77th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we raise a glass to Mark Knopfler, turning 77! The Dire Straits legend, master of the guitar riff, still sounds incredible.

angles.name: Sultans of Swing
angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to a stellar solo career, Mark Knopfler's influence is undeniable. Happy 77th for tomorrow, Mark!

moments.title: Soprano Sarah Brightman is 66

angles.name: Voice of an Angel
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 66th Birthday to the incomparable Sarah Brightman this Thursday! Her voice is truly a gift.

angles.name: 60s Drummer
angles.copy: Happy 84th Birthday for Friday to Pete York! The powerhouse drummer behind The Spencer Davis Group's biggest hits.

angles.name: Queen of Pop

angles.name: Iconic Career
angles.copy: From 'Like A Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna has redefined pop music for decades. Happy 68th Birthday for Saturday to an absolute legend!

angles.name: INXS Guitar Legend

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place
